name: Graphics Drawing & Barcode (Graphics & Barcode)
description: Provides canvas creation, shape and text drawing, image overlay, watermarking, and mosaic redaction

CreateCanvas.description: Create a new blank canvas image with custom dimensions and background color

DrawRect.description: Draw rectangles on an image with customizable stroke width, fill color, and labels

DrawShape.description: Draw circles, lines, arrows, or polygons on an image

DrawText.description: Render text on image with custom font, size, color, and shadow effects

DrawImage.description: Overlay sub-images, logos, or stamps onto a background image with transparency control

DrawWatermark.description: Apply repeated tilted watermark across the entire image to prevent unauthorized copying

FillColor.description: Fill designated region with solid color or blur with mosaic to redact sensitive data

BarcodeCreate.description: Generate high-resolution 1D barcodes or customized QR code graphics
